identity.name: Casio Royale
identity.one_liner: The $25 digital field watch nicknamed for its James Bond resemblance — the most feature-rich Casio at the bottom of the catalogue, with world time and a 10-year battery.

narrative.story: The AE-1200 (dubbed the "Casio Royale" for its resemblance to a watch in Casino Royale media) is the feature-dense entry in Casio's digital line: world time (31 time zones, 48 cities), a 1/100-second stopwatch, a countdown timer, five daily alarms, an LED backlight, and a 10-year battery. The 42.4mm resin case has a 100m water resistance — more than most digitals at this price. The AE-1200 is the most-cited affordable digital after the F-91W and the watch a collector cites when they want maximum function per dollar.
narrative.collector_notes: The AE-1200 and the AE-1500 share the 3768 module. The "Royale" nickname is collector slang; the watch has no official Bond association. The case screws are decorative.
